methods.name: no_compression
methods.description: Training trajectory without lossy checkpoint restoration.

methods.name: excp_style
methods.description: Residual-magnitude scoring with exact global top-k selection under the same residual sparsity and recovery protocol; excludes ExCP optimizer compression and quantization.

methods.name: inshrinkerator_style
methods.description: Full-weight first-order sensitivity |g*theta| with exact global top-k selection, transferred to the same residual sparsity and recovery protocol; excludes the full partition, search, and encoding pipeline.

methods.name: first_order_exact_global
methods.description: Residual first-order damage |g*delta| from the true-label gradient with exact global top-k selection.

methods.name: taylor_exact_global
methods.description: Taylor HVP scoring with exact global top-k allocation oracle.

methods.name: dacp
methods.description: Taylor damage scoring with Weibull moment allocation.

methods.name: probe_topk_m1_exact_global
methods.description: Residual damage |-g*delta + 0.5*delta*(F_hat delta)| with 1 deterministic top-probability Gauss-Newton probe round(s); exact global top-k selection.

methods.name: probe_sample_m1_exact_global
methods.description: Residual damage |-g*delta + 0.5*delta*(F_hat delta)| with 1 sampled Gauss-Newton probe round(s) (y ~ p, de-duplicated per position, Rademacher signs); exact global top-k selection.

methods.name: probe_headtail_m2_exact_global
methods.description: Residual damage |-g*delta + 0.5*delta*(F_hat delta)| with 1 deterministic head round(s) plus one renormalised tail sample (unbiased for the full Gauss-Newton matrix); exact global top-k selection.
